name: Key Custody
description: Scoped evidence-based assessment. Display order is not an assurance threshold. Apply to an explicit subject and comparison scope; the value alone grants no authority.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: Evaluation could not establish the requested claim in the stated scope.

values.label: Not applicable
values.description: No key is involved in this assessment.

values.label: Software
values.description: Private material held in software within the stated boundary.

values.label: Os managed
values.description: Key access mediated by an OS service; hardware custody unestablished.

values.label: Hardware backed
values.description: Evidence establishes private operations inside the specified hardware boundary.

values.label: Virtual hardware backed
values.description: Evidence establishes a virtual security-device boundary with host and migration assumptions explicit.
